notes: The supplied pages are mostly institution-wide or belong to other programmes (Chemistry, Vaktherapie, Ergotherapie, Circular Economy, Ad Bedrijfskunde). The only page about this programme (https://www.han.nl/opleidingen/hbo/ict/voltijd/) gives: the start moments '1 februari 2027 en 1 september 2027' (years are stated) and the instruction 'Meld je voor 1 mei 2025 aan voor ICT!'; that deadline names a day, month and year but for study year 2025-2026, which does not match the 2027 start dates, so it is reported here only as text, not as an intake deadline. The page also mentions that admission is possible with 'een mbo-, havo- of vwo-diploma', but no requirement about a foreign diploma (e.g. Moroccan Baccalaureat) can be quoted for this programme, and international/Nuffic rules appear only in other programmes' regulations, so no requirements are included. The general collegegeld page distinguishes 'Instellingstarief Laag/Hoog/Top' for 'niet-EER-studenten' but does not tie a concrete non-EU fee to ICT, so no tuition fact is included. No teaching-language, duration, document list or Studielink application statement could be quoted for ICT specifically. Soft phrases (e.g. 'aanbevolen', matching) are not requirements.
